cards.title: Check in with Corpus Departure
cards.leadIn: At 500' MSL, when directed by Tower, contact Corpus Departure (UHF CH 8) and remain there for Foxtrot:

exchange.speaker: Pilot
exchange.text: Corpus Departure, <callsign>, 500 feet off Navy Corpus, Foxtrot.

exchange.speaker: Departure
exchange.text: <callsign>, Corpus Departure, radar contact <distance and direction> of Navy Corpus. Proceed course rules Foxtrot.

cards.source: Binder, p. 16; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 78.
